producthunt.name: Rakazo
producthunt.tagline: The open source Grok Bot alternative you actually own
producthunt.description: Rakazo gives you AI teammates that keep working after you close the chat. Each bot has its own memory, routines and computer, with a browser you can watch and take over. Open source and self-hosted: any model, your keys, your machine. Web, desktop and mobile.

producthunt.name: HiringNow
producthunt.tagline: AI job agent that finds & apply for jobs before anyone else.
producthunt.description: HiringNow checks 247,000+ company career sites every 5 minutes, so you see new jobs before they hit the big boards. It matches each job to your profile, tailors your resume and cover letter, and applies on the employer's own site, only with your approval. Every application gets a receipt in your job tracker. Also: resume builder and mock interviews. Free plan with 10 auto-applies.
